questions.prompt: Which statement correctly distinguishes the two funding amounts for shortlisted places?
options: Each receives £10 million, while £125,000 is shared by the winner’s partners.
Each receives at least £125,000, while one winner receives the £10 million prize.
Each receives £60,000 instead of £125,000 if it remains on the shortlist.
Each receives £125,000 only after the £10 million prize has been spent.
questions.explanationZh: s5分别规定短名单各地至少125,000英镑和最终获胜者一千万英镑；s6明确不能把大奖视作每地已获资金。

questions.prompt: Why can the bidding process have value for an unsuccessful place?
options: It can cover the cost of implementing the unsuccessful bid.
It can secure a place in the following shortlist.
It can turn panel feedback into a funded events programme.
It can strengthen a cultural strategy and connect partners.
questions.explanationZh: s17说明申办可帮助制定文化战略并形成合作，s19补充未成功者仍获反馈；正文未承诺承担未成功方案的实施费用、下次入围名额，或把反馈转为已获资助的活动项目。

questions.prompt: What population does the 87 percent figure describe?
options: Audiences of Bradford 2025.
All residents in the four shortlisted places.
Organisations receiving Bradford investment.
All applicants to the 2029 competition.
questions.explanationZh: s15明确为Bradford 2025 audiences，s16警示不能扩大成全体居民。

questions.prompt: What prevents the Bradford figures from being compared as counts of the same outcome?
options: They were collected in different competition years.
They describe different kinds of participation and support.
They all refer to the same group of residents.
They exclude projects run by funded organisations.
questions.explanationZh: s12–s14分别讨论活动数、获得投资的机构数和参与居民数，三者对象不同，不能当作同一种结果的计数；正文未说年份不同、都是同一批居民或排除受资助机构项目。

questions.prompt: Which conclusion best reflects the article’s treatment of the competition?
options: Winning matters, but the process and reported benefits require separate assessment.
Past participation figures settle which shortlisted place should receive the title.
The main value of the competition is distributing identical grants to all applicants.
Unsuccessful applications matter chiefly as evidence of weak local cultural activity.
questions.explanationZh: 文章既承认称号价值，又区分申办过程价值和既往证据对未来预测的边界，并未用过去数字决定胜者或贬低失败者。
